customrecordtype.description: Configuration for Click-to-Call. Managed exclusively by the Setup Wizard SPA. Hidden from admin UI via allowuiaccess=F; edit only via the wizard. Runtime reads remain open (accesstype=NONENEEDED) so non-admin scripts (poller, softphone, phone-button) can read config without role-checking workarounds (per SAFE Guide §5.2).

customrecordcustomfield.label: API Key Secret ID
customrecordcustomfield.description: Script ID from Setup > Company > API Secrets (e.g., custsecret_ctc_api_key_secret)

customrecordcustomfield.label: CTC Activated
customrecordcustomfield.description: Flipped to T by the v2 Setup Wizard when all preflight checks pass. The phone-icon User Event script reads this flag and stays hidden until activation succeeds, so reps never see a half-configured icon. Default F on fresh installs.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Inbound Calls Enabled
customrecordcustomfield.description: When checked, the phone token lets Twilio ring the rep's browser phone (client identity = employee internal id) for inbound calls. Default F: outbound only.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Inbound Ring Seconds
customrecordcustomfield.description: How long an inbound call rings the assigned rep's browser phone before the caller hears the no-answer message. Whole seconds, 10 to 60. Blank means 20.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Inbound No-Answer Message
customrecordcustomfield.description: Spoken to an inbound caller when the rep does not answer or the dialed number has no rep. Blank means the built-in default message.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Inbound Studio Flow SID
customrecordcustomfield.description: SID (FW...) of the Twilio Studio flow that NetSuite generates and publishes for inbound routing. Written by the Setup Wizard.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Inbound Routing Published At
customrecordcustomfield.description: ISO 8601 time of the last successful publish of the inbound routing flow. Written by the Setup Wizard.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Record Inbound Calls
customrecordcustomfield.description: When checked, the inbound routing flow records each answered inbound call (Studio Connect Call To with Record on) so it is transcribed and analyzed like an outbound call. Checked by default.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Play Inbound Recording Notice
customrecordcustomfield.description: When checked and inbound recording is on, every inbound caller hears the recording notice once before the rep's phone rings. Checked by default.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Inbound Recording Notice
customrecordcustomfield.description: Spoken to an inbound caller before the call is connected and recorded. Blank means the built-in notice.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Call Reconciliation Watermark
customrecordcustomfield.description: ISO 8601 UTC time. Every Twilio browser call that ended before this time has a Phone Call. Written by the transcript poller (call reconciliation). Blank means the next run looks back 7 days.
